subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the source of the rumbling noise

222000102.text: Ugh, my stomach is making an awful racket again. I was saying, do you need any *RUMBLE*

222000104.text: *sigh* My stomach acts up like this every time I'm hungry. Rumble this and rumble that, and it's really loud, too. I can't even hear the sound of my own voice.

222000105.text: Although *RUMBLE* went to Bubu Pharmacy to get myself checked, but the doctor said that I was not sick, just hungry — so there's no cure for my *GROWL*

222000106.text: The doctor said that I just needed to eat full meals, but I... I've always had a bigger *GRUMBLE* than most. If I were to eat my fill every time, I'd burn a hole right through my wallet.

222000107.text: Jiayi tells me that if my main meals don't fill me up yet, I should buy a little something to fill in the gaps in between so it doesn't affect my work.

222000108.text: "Fill in the gaps," he says, but I've got a long list of dishes I'd like to eat, and I'm not sure which is best for filling my stomach.

222000109.text: Traveler, you're experienced in the outdoor life. Surely you know what foods fill your stomach best?

222000110.text: Could you help me pick the most filling and delicious dish from my list?

222000111.text: What would you like to eat this time?

222000112.text: Oh, there's plenty... Let me think...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Yicheng a dish that can fill his stomach

222000201.text: Oh, I've heard there's some great-tasting dishes from Mondstadt — Sweet Madame, Mondstadt Grilled Fish, Fisherman's Toast, Calla Lily Seafood Soup...

222000202.text: Well, just get me the one that'll best fill my stomach. Thanks for your help!

222000203.text: If I eat that, at least my stomach won't be crying out all day...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Yicheng a dish that can fill his stomach

222000301.text: Have you found that filling dish yet?

222000303.text: Great, let me have a taste.

222000305.text: Alright. If you mean to get Fisherman's Toast, I know that the Wanmin Restaurant usually sells it.

222000307.text: Hmm, I've heard a merchant from Mondstadt say that the Good Hunter has this Calla Lily Seafood Soup. I think it could be pretty good.

222000308.text: Speaking of Mondstadt dishes, Grilled Fish and Sweet Madame should be quite simple to make.

222000309.text: *RUMBLE* ...Ah, even just saying the names of these dishes out loud is making me hungrier still...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Yicheng a dish that can fill his stomach

222000401.text: I'm craving some Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup but also some Black-Back Perch Stew... though some Mondstadt dishes also catch my fancy. A Chicken-Mushroom Skewer wouldn't go amiss, nor would a Tea Break Pancake or several...

222000402.text: Well, just get me the one that will best fill my stomach. Thanks for your help!

222000403.text: If I eat that, at least my stomach won't be crying out all day...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Yicheng a dish that can fill his stomach

222000501.text: Have you found that filling dish yet?

222000503.text: Great, let me have a taste.

222000505.text: I've heard that Chef Mao of the Wanmin Restaurant knows how to make Black-Back Perch Stew — you can ask him.

222000506.text: As for Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup, I think Herbalist Gui knows the recipe. He works at Bubu Pharmacy in Yujing Terrace if you need to ask him about it.

222000507.text: I've heard from a merchant that the Tea Break Pancakes from Good Hunter in Mondstadt taste really good, and are very filling as well.

222000508.text: As for Chicken-Mushroom Skewers... Surely they can't be that hard to make?

222000509.text: *RUMBLE* ...Ah, even just saying the names of these dishes out loud is making me hungrier still...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Yicheng a dish that can fill his stomach

222000601.text: I'd kill for some Squirrel Fish or Jueyun Chili Chicken, but I've heard that Mondstadt dishes like Cream Stew and Teyvat Fried Egg are really good too.

222000602.text: Just thinking about it makes me *RUMBLE*

222000603.text: Please help me out and get me one of those dishes... I just need my stomach to stop *GROWL* for the day...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Yicheng a dish that can fill his stomach

222000701.text: Have you found that filling dish yet?

222000703.text: Great, let me have a taste.

222000705.text: You can consult Chef Mao of the Wanmin Restaurant as to how to make Squirrel Fish and Jueyun Chili Chicken.

222000706.text: I've heard Mondstadt merchants say that the Good Hunter has something they call Cream Stew. I wonder how that might taste...

222000707.text: Teyvat Fried Egg should be really easy to make, or so I *RUMBLE*

222000708.text: *RUMBLE* ...Ah, even just saying the names of these dishes out loud is making me hungrier still...

222001001.text: This smells odd. The ingredients haven't been cut properly, and this chunk here isn't even well-cooked!

222001002.text: Well, it doesn't seem promising, but it's got quantity, so it'll at least keep my stomach quiet.

222001003.text: *burp* Thank you. This is just a token of my appreciation. Please take it. *burp*

222001101.text: This taste, this smell, it's wonderful!

222001102.text: The quantity is sufficient, as well. I just can't get enough! My stomach isn't grumbling anymore, either! *burp*

222001103.text: It's just that now that I'm full, I can't help burping. *burp*

222001104.text: Thank you so much. Please take this as a token of my appreciation. *burp*

222001201.text: This taste is... really odd. Feels like it was left overnight. Not at all like I was told it would taste.

222001202.text: The texture is bad, almost like chewing on sand... The quantity is small as well. Why, I finished it in one or two bites.

222001203.text: *sigh* This won't be enough for sure. Guess I'll have to go look for something else to chew on...

222001204.text: Still, thank you, friend. Please take this as thanks.

222001301.text: This dish is well-made indeed. A lot of effort must have gone into it, and it does taste great.

222001302.text: Still... there's a bit too little of it. Can't fill my stomach like this.

222001303.text: It was still nice to eat such a delicious *RUMBLE* though...
